live-read: He stops typing; ≈3.9 s later the pencil underline draws under the passage being read, the reading blot breathes, and at ≈6 s the question inks in word by word in the margin with its tether (faux model, Regular pace 1600 ms + 700 ms think).
Reduced: the underline and note appear finished, no stroke draw or word stagger.
tether-draw: Opening a note draws its tether: tie then spine (≈0.56 s + 0.7 s). Reduced: drawn at once.
thread-unfold: The thread unfolds in place (.34 s), the others fade to .38. Reduced: opens at once.
sketch-draw-in: Visualize → "Here it is, one step at a time." inks in, then the drawing plays its four steps (grid, cells, arrows) on its own once. Reduced: the steps change without strokes drawing.
chat-panel-open: The panel slides in (.28 s) while the page slides 210 px left and fades to .5. Reduced: both at once.
sidebar-open: The sidebar slides in (.18 s) and the page slides aside and fades; the notes keep their sides (fixed in this pass: right notes used to jump into the left margin). Reduced: at once.
theme-cross-fade: Light → Dark cross-fades over .35 s (view transition). Reduced: instant.
